# City Pass Index (citypassindex.com)

> Independent comparison of city tourist passes: verified pass prices, attraction gate prices, break-even maths and a calculator. No pay-to-play rankings.

## Key pages
- https://citypassindex.com/ — start here: pass comparison and calculator
- https://citypassindex.com/calculator.html — New York CityPASS break-even calculator
- https://citypassindex.com/passes.html — CityPASS, Go City and New York Pass compared
- https://citypassindex.com/data.html — downloadable CSV of 15 New York attraction gate prices
- https://citypassindex.com/cities.html — cities with checked data
- https://citypassindex.com/new-york.html — New York CityPASS, checked November 2026
- https://citypassindex.com/philadelphia.html — Philadelphia CityPASS, checked November 2026
- https://citypassindex.com/boston.html — Boston CityPASS, checked November 2026
- https://citypassindex.com/chicago.html — Chicago CityPASS, checked November 2026
- https://citypassindex.com/go-city-vs-citypass.html — Go City Explorer vs CityPASS
- https://citypassindex.com/methodology.html — how prices are checked
- https://citypassindex.com/about.html — who runs the site
- https://citypassindex.com/contact.html — contact

## Content policy
- Prices are adult "from" rates checked against official sellers; each page states its checked date.
- Cities without verified prices are marked "in research" rather than given placeholder numbers.
- Downloadable data: https://citypassindex.com/data.html (CC BY 4.0, attribution City Pass Index).
- Content signal: search=yes, ai-train=no.
